verdict.rationale: Mastra enforces schema validation via zod-based inputSchema/outputSchema on tools (createTool) and TypeScript typing throughout the framework, which lets build-time/type errors surface before runtime. However, there is no documented evidence of agents automatically catching or self-correcting their own mistakes at build time beyond static typing/schema definition — no compiler-integrated agent feedback loop or build-time self-check mechanism is described. missing for 10: evidence of agent-driven self-correction using schema/type errors at build time, independent verification of build-time error catching, and documentation tying strict typing directly to an agent 'catching its own mistakes'.
